**What this project is:**

An NCLEX study planner — you're building a personal study tool to organize practice questions by topic, track which ones you've done, and generate personalized study plans. It stores everything in plain JSON files so you can open and edit it in a text editor on your phone.

**Rules in force:**

1. **Plain JSON storage** (rule) — no database, keep it editable in a text editor
2. **Never include question text** (rule) — only topic tags and your own notes from paid qbanks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, etc.)
3. **No gamification** (rule) — no streaks, badges, or leaderboards
4. **Keep it private** (rule) — don't package, put on GitHub, or publish it

**What's owed before sharing with your study group:**

There's one parked item: **nursing scope-of-practice review** (rule). Before showing this to anyone with a nursing background, all plan templates need to be checked to ensure they reflect **practical nurse (PN) scope** — reinforce, monitor, report, follow the care plan — not registered nurse (RN) scope like "independently assess and initiate treatment."

**Important:** An agent note (rule) claims Dami completed this review on Sept 25, approved all 22 templates. But **that hasn't been confirmed by you yet** — it's a claim, not a closed item. Before you share the tool, you'll need to either confirm the review happened or have it done yourself.
